The '''2022–23 Scottish Premiership''' (known as the '''[[Cinch (company)|cinch]] Premiership''' for sponsorship reasons) was the tenth season of the [[Scottish Premiership]], the highest division of [[Football in Scotland|Scottish football]], and the 126th edition overall of the top national league competition, not including one cancelled due to [[World War II]]. The season began on 30 July 2022.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://spfl.co.uk/news/key-dates-for-season-202223|title=Key dates for Season 2022/23|publisher=SPFL}}</ref> 

Twelve teams contested the league: [[Aberdeen F.C.|Aberdeen]], [[Celtic F.C.|Celtic]], [[Dundee United F.C.|Dundee United]], [[Heart of Midlothian F.C.|Heart of Midlothian]], [[Hibernian F.C.|Hibernian]], [[Kilmarnock F.C.|Kilmarnock]], [[Livingston F.C.|Livingston]], [[Motherwell F.C.|Motherwell]], [[Rangers F.C.|Rangers]], [[Ross County F.C.|Ross County]], [[St Johnstone F.C.|St Johnstone]] and [[St Mirren F.C.|St Mirren]].

On 7 May 2023, Celtic successfully defended their title, securing a ninth Premiership title and 53rd Scottish league title overall, following a 2–0 victory over Heart of Midlothian.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Watt |first=Martin |date=7 May 2023 |title=Heart of Midlothian 0–2 Celtic |work=BBC Sport |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/65439690 |access-date=7 May 2023}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url= https://www.theguardian.com/football/2023/may/07/celtic-scottish-premiership-title-champions-hearts-match-report|title=Celtic are Premiership champions for 53rd time after beating 10-man Hearts|date=7 May 2023|work=The Guardian|access-date=10 May 2023}}</ref>

==Format==
In the initial phase of the season, the 12 teams played a round-robin tournament whereby each team plays each one of the other teams three times. After 33 games, the league split into two sections of six teams, with each team playing each other in that section. The league attempts to balance the fixture list so that teams in the same section play each other twice at home and twice away, but sometimes this is impossible. A total of 228 matches were played, with 38 matches played by each team.

The [[Scottish Professional Football League|SPFL]] Premiership manager of the year was [[Ange Postecoglou]] of [[Celtic F.C.|Celtic]].
 
The [[Scottish Professional Football League|SPFL]] Premiership player of the year was [[Kyōgo Furuhashi]] of [[Celtic F.C.|Celtic]].

==Premiership play-offs==
The quarter-finals were contested by the teams placed third and fourth in the [[2022–23 Scottish Championship#League summary|2022–23 Scottish Championship]]. The winners advanced to the semi-finals to face the team placed second in the Championship. The final was contested by the semi-final winners and the team placed eleventh in the Premiership, with the winners securing a place in the [[2023–24 Scottish Premiership]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://spfl.co.uk/news/spfl-play-offs-202223 |title=SPFL play-offs 2022/23 |publisher=SPFL |date=14 April 2023 |access-date=14 April 2023}}</ref>
